crossRefs.note: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

translations.web: But when the blade sprang up and produced fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
translations.bsb: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.
translations.kjv: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
translations.asv: But when the blade sprang up and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
